upstream_build: scripts/build.sh: gcc -O2 -std=c11 -Idsp dsp/*.c; g++ -O3 -std=c++14 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fvisibility=hidden -Idsp -Idsp/engines dsp/engines/*.cpp; gcc -O3 -std=c11 -fvisibility=hidden dsp/engines/*.c; link -shared; dist/dr32/{dsp.so,ui.js,module.json,browser.js,resample.js,canvas.js,env_card.js,chain_params.json,engine_ui.json,engine_tpl.json,samples/,LICENSE,NOTICES.md,help.json}
wasm_notes: Kits normally come from Move's factory .ablpreset library (not redistributable); the smoke test runs with whatever the engine synthesises without a kit. -D_GNU_SOURCE: musl hides clock_gettime under strict -std=c11 (glibc doesn't).
